eyebrow: A verified exact result — QFT on |01>
code:
QFT|01> = 0.5|00> + 0.5i|01> - 0.5|10> - 0.5i|11>

|amplitude| = 0.5 for every output -> P(each outcome) = 0.25
phases step by 90 degrees per output index: 0, 90, 180, 270
caption: Every output is equally likely — the information is in the relative phases, not which basis state you measure.
